audit.split: uniform seeded reservoir of up to 200,000 valid Monday-Thursday rows split by feature signatures 60/20/20; all valid Friday flows held out
cleaning: Trim column names; verify duplicate Fwd Header Length and use one copy.
Convert infinite numeric measurements and -1 initial-window sentinels to missing; impute using fit-partition medians.
Drop other negative measurement rows and missing labels.
Remove binary-label-conflicting signatures and development signatures shared with the Friday test.
limitations: Development is a 200,000-row maximum uniform sample, not full-data training.
Friday is day-held-out; CSVs lack timestamps, endpoints and session IDs.
Friday categories include DDoS, PortScan and Bot, absent from the Monday-Thursday category pool. Binary detection is tested, not category prediction or real zero-day detection.
No UNSW-to-CIC transfer is claimed; feature schemas differ.

dashboard_sample.selection: uniform test sample, seed 42; dashboard figures apply to this sample only
